text:
maya: FYI BillMesh renewal quote landed and the numbers don't match our usage export. Can finance + procurement take a look?

sam: link?

maya: https://drive.redwood/billmesh/renewal-quote-2149.pdf — quick excerpt: they bucket embeddings + gen under "compute" and apply a "minimum monthly commit" that appears to double-count cached tokens.

oliver: we've seen their SDK inflate per-request token counts when KV cache is enabled, cc @jordan — ops observed odd spikes last month.

jordan: can you paste the invoice lines here? also ask them for raw usage CSV — last time they only gave aggregated JSON which blocked reconciliation.

maya: CSV sample pasted from vendor export: "2025-11-02,embeddings,120000,240.00" 

sam: procurement to BillMesh: please provide per-resource (embeddings,generation,storage,cache-ops) breakdown, the raw per-request CSV for Oct–Dec 2025, and confirm how KV cache is metered. Also propose a one-time true-up credit if we were overcharged this quarter.

billmesh_sales: Thanks for flagging — we'll produce the raw CSV and a per-resource breakout by EOD tomorrow. If discrepancy >5% we'll apply a one-time adjustment; assigning account mgr @alex_bm to this thread.

katie: legal note — before signing renewal add: meter transparency (raw per-request logs), quarterly true-up clause, and 30-day audit access for metering. Also include a 60-day termination without penalty if metering is proven noncompliant.

maya: sounds good. Sam — can you get a ballpark impact vs current spend? If the adjustment is < $5k we might push renewal and negotiate stronger metering terms for next cycle.

sam: on it. I'll request the 90-day raw sample and ask for a CSV schema. ETA EOD tomorrow, will loop in procurement counsel if needed.

jordan: ops note — if they provide raw usage we can run our reconciliation script: `reconcile --vendor billmesh --from 2025-10-01 --to 2026-01-01`. Please ensure timestamps are UTC and include request IDs.

oliver: also check dev/staging tagging — last time we found prod/staging mixups that inflated billing.

billmesh_sales: raw CSV shared (Drive link). Alex (account mgr) will follow up with the schema and a preliminary reconciled spreadsheet. Apologies for the confusion, we want to sort this quickly.

maya: thanks — will review once received and escalate if numbers still don't match.
__notes: Document is a single Slack thread string. Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names. No title field per agents.md.
